title: Function to Class
description: Convert 3 standalone functions into static methods of a Calculator class.
tips:
1. Select functions (e.g. 'v' then move down, or repeated x).
2. Change 'calculate' to 'get' ('s' -> 'calculate' -> 'c').
3. with multi select open line above all functions using ('O'), type '@staticmethod'.
4. Refactor bodies: Use delete/change to simplify returns.
5. Wrap in class: Select all lines ('x'), indent ('>'), go to top ('gg'), add 'class Calculator:'.
